Containers.Name: Network UPS Tools (NUT) for UNRAID
Containers.Description: Monitor uninterruptible power supplies (UPS) and other power devices locally or over the network - supports a wide range of brands and enables graceful shutdown during power loss scenarios. Fork of Network UPS Tools (NUT) for UNRAID by desertwitch (Rysz), whose plugin loses upstream support on 30.11.2026.
